summary: App to manage products and sales with Internet Identity login, product CRUD, sales recording with profit calculation, dashboard summaries and low-stock alerts, and optional WhatsApp integration (later/optional).
architectural_notes: OTP login (email/phone) not supported; use Internet Identity for authentication.
WhatsApp integration is optional for v1 and may be limited to frontend API calls only.

existing_features.title: Implement authentication using Internet Identity (passkey-based) and gate all app features behind a signed-in session.
Add a simple onboarding/profile setup flow for first-time users after Internet Identity login (e.g., store display name and default low-stock threshold) and persist it per user principal.

Implement Product Management: create, list, edit, and delete products with fields sufficient for sales/profit calculations and low-stock alerts (at minimum: name, cost price, sale price, current stock quantity, low-stock threshold override or use default).

Implement Sales Recording: provide a simple sales form to record a sale for a product (date/time, product, quantity, unit sale price optional override, unit cost price sourced from product, notes optional) and automatically compute profit for the sale; update inventory stock accordingly.

Create a Dashboard that shows (a) daily summary metrics for the selected day (e.g., total sales count, revenue, cost, profit) and (b) a low-stock alert list based on per-product threshold (product override or user default).

Add an optional Notifications settings area that clearly marks WhatsApp notifications as ‘not enabled in v1’ and provides a placeholder UI for future integration without attempting real WhatsApp API integration.

Define and apply a cohesive, distinctive visual theme for the app (colors, typography, spacing, component style) and use it consistently across onboarding, products, sales, and dashboard screens (avoid blue/purple as primary colors).

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement user login & onboarding using Internet Identity (passkey-based) instead of email/phone OTP
Sales recording: simple form with automatic profit calculation
Dashboard: daily summary plus low-stock alerts
Optional WhatsApp notifications integration (likely frontend API calls only for first version)

projectName: Inventory & Sales Tracker with Internet Identity login, product CRUD, sales recording, and dashboard alerts
